description_full: HUYA Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates game live streaming platforms in the People's Republic of China. Its platforms enable broadcasters and viewers to interact during live streaming. The company offers non-game entertainment content, such as talent shows, anime, outdoor activities, live chats, and online theatre. In addition, it operates Nimo TV, a game live streaming platform; and promotes and distributes game applications in international markets. Further, the company provides online advertising, software development, internet value added, and cultural and creative services. It serves broadcasters and talent agencies. The company was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China. HUYA Inc. operates as a subsidiary of Tencent Holdings Limited.
